rationale: Anthony brings deep production experience in energy systems and cyber-physical infrastructure from PG&E, combined with conviction that graph neural networks outperform LLMs for structured enterprise data—exactly the kind of real-world ML infrastructure challenge Qing tackles at AWS. They share ML research as a core domain and could explore how production-grade analytics approaches (rather than LLM-first solutions) apply to sustainable infrastructure problems at scale.
intro_message: Anthony James, meet Qing Sun — Anthony's done expert-level ML work on energy infrastructure and cyber-physical systems at PG&E, and Qing leads applied science on ML infrastructure at AWS; you two should compare notes on what actually works for structured, mission-critical data problems.
